title: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Acquisition Amendment Act 2020

sections.shortTitle: Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Acquisition Amendment Act 2020
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT XVIII OF 2020
ACT XVIII OF 2020
KHYBER PAKHTUNKHWA LAND ACQUISITION (AMENDMENT)
ACT, 2020
An Act further to amend the Land Acquisition Act,
1894
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
4th March, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-92 / 2020/6267, dated 4.3.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Acquisition
(Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 24th February, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd March, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Act No. I of 1894) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing:
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as
follows:
1. Short
title and commencement.---(1) This
Act may be called the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act,
2020.
(2) It
shall come into force at once.

ACT XVIII OF 2020
ACT XVIII OF 2020

1894
[Gazette of Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Extraordinary,
4th March, 2020]
No.
PA / Khyber Pakhtunkhwa / Bills-92 / 2020/6267, dated 4.3.2020.---The Khyber Pakhtunkhwa Land Acquisition
(Amendment) Bill, 2020 having been passed by the Provincial Assembly of Khyber
Pakhtunkhwa on 24th February, 2020 and assented to by the Governor of the
Khyber Pakhtunkhwa on 2nd March, 2020 is hereby published as an Act of the
Provincial Legislature of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa.
Preamble.---WHEREAS it is expedient further to amend the
Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Act No. I of 1894) for the purposes hereinafter
appearing:
It
is hereby enacted by the Provincial Assembly of the Khyber Pakhtunkhwa as
follows:
2. Addition
of new section 11-C to the Act No. I of 1894.---In the Land Acquisition Act, 1894 (Act I of 1894), after the existing
section 11-B, the following, new section 11-C shall be added, namely:
"11-C
Acquisition in newly merged areas.---Notwithstanding
anything contained in this Act or any other law for the time being in force, in
the Merged Districts as defined in paragraph (c) of Article 246 of the
Constitution of Islamic Republic of Pakistan, where no record of rights exists,
the land acquisition and subsequent determination of price shall be made, on
the basis of prevailing local customs, traditions and usages regarding
determination of ownership of land and its sale or purchase, including but not
limited to qaumi commission of elders of the locality, nikat or private
negotiation where the ownership is undisputed, in the manner as may be
prescribed.".
